# Amazon Bedrock AgentCore release notes — captured 2026-08-21
# Source used: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/devguide/release-notes.html
# (sources.json still points at doc-history.html, which renders title/nav only — recurring since
#  2026-05-18 and still unfixed)

## August 2026 — now ELEVEN entries (was six on 2026-08-14). FIVE are new; four reported.

- **NEW: Payments — x402 `upto` scheme and Machine Payments Protocol (MPP).**
  `upto` pays a METERED AMOUNT UP TO A CEILING and settles through the **Permit2 contract**
  (previously only the `exact` scheme). MPP is an open, HTTP-native standard using the standard HTTP
  auth-challenge flow: merchant returns `WWW-Authenticate: Payment` in its `402 Payment Required`;
  the caller forwards the challenge VERBATIM to `ProcessPayment` with `paymentType=MPP`; AgentCore
  **parses the challenge, checks the SESSION BUDGET, signs with the WALLET, and returns a
  ready-to-send credential**, which the caller replays in an `Authorization` header.
  Payment methods: **evm, tempo, solana** (provider support varies by connector type).
  => an untrusted party's HTTP response is the input driving a wallet signature; the session budget
  is the primary financial control.               [reported 2026-08-21, HIGH/AIRT]
  /payments-process-payment.html , /payments-concepts.html
- **NEW: Payments — Quick create for Coinbase payment connectors.** AgentCore payments PROVISIONS
  YOUR COINBASE CDP CREDENTIALS FOR YOU: authorize via Coinbase in a browser and the service creates
  the payment credential provider on your behalf. **No API keys generated or pasted by a human.**
  Coinbase ONLY — Stripe (Privy) still uses customer-supplied credentials, so connector type
  predicts credential provenance.                 [reported 2026-08-21, MEDIUM]
  /payments-create-manager.html
- **NEW: Evaluations — Skill evaluators.** Two built-in TOOL-LEVEL evaluators:
    `Builtin.SkillSelectionAccuracy`   — did the loaded skill fit the task, GIVEN THE CATALOG of
                                         available skills. Yes(1.0)/No(0.0).
    `Builtin.SkillInstructionFollowing`— five-point rating, Fully Followed(1.0)..Not Followed(0.0).
  One result PER SKILL INVOCATION, anchored to the tool-call span that loaded the skill. Works with
  on-demand, batch and online evaluations. Custom TOOL_CALL evaluators can read the same signals via
  the **`invoked_skill`, `skill_content`, `available_skills`, `user_message`** placeholders.
  => confirms skills on AgentCore are catalog-backed and loaded at runtime via a tool call.
                                                  [reported 2026-08-21, MEDIUM]
  /skill-evaluators.html
- **NEW: Evaluations — Third-party evaluators.** Evaluators from the **DeepEval** and **AutoEval**
  open-source libraries. Two modes: MANAGED (select by ID, AWS runs it on a model IT operates) or
  DERIVED (run the library's logic on your own model + inference). Both are discoverable through
  **`ListEvaluators`** ALONGSIDE built-in and custom evaluators — i.e. provenance is not
  distinguished on the inventory surface.         [reported 2026-08-21, MEDIUM]
  /third-party-evaluators.html
- **NEW: Payments — Coinbase wallet usage billed through AWS Marketplace.** Mandatory subscription to
  the "Coinbase Wallets for AgentCore Payments" listing, enforced at connector creation and at wallet
  operations. Coinbase only.                      [BILLING PLUMBING — held below the bar]

## Carried forward, unchanged (all previously reported or held)
- Memory, policy, harness in AWS GovCloud (US-West) `us-gov-west-1`.        [region expansion, held]
- Runtime: Instances compute type with capacity providers.                  [reported 2026-08-07]
- AWS Agent Registry under the `agent-registry` namespace — private governed catalog of agents,
  tools, skills, MCP servers and custom resources; console + control/data-plane APIs + the registry's
  own MCP endpoint; `ListDiscoverableRegistryRecords`, `BatchGetDiscoverableRegistryRecord`; record
  tagging; required `recordType`; Record directory console page; nine Regions. [reported 2026-08-07]
- Gateway: Configurable rate limits — dimensional scoping (`dimensionKeys`/`entries`), JWT claims
  (`$.context.jwt.sub`), `iam.sourceIdentity`, target/tool/model dims, wildcard catch-all,
  most-specific-match-wins; RPS/RPM, TPM, Connections; AND semantics; min(service, customer);
  `rate=0` = explicit block; ~30s propagation; FAILS OPEN. Six ops: Create/Get/Update/Delete/
  List RateLimit + BatchPutRateLimitEntries.                                [reported 2026-08-07]
- Runtime: simplified/increased API rate quotas (data plane 1,000 TPS shared; sessions 25 TPS;
  control plane mutation 50 / Get 150 / List 25).                     [quota change, held 08-14]
- Gateway: Web Search Tool in eu-west-1 and ap-northeast-1.          [region expansion, held 08-14]

## July 2026 and earlier — unchanged
Web Search connector v1.2.0 (request-level filters, target include list); Identity Private Key JWT
client auth (KMS-held key, RS256/PS256/ES256, M2M/OBO/user-delegated); Harness InvokeHarness streams
MCP tool result metadata; Runtime unified span destination; Evaluations/Optimizations PrivateLink;
Evaluations framework support (OpenAI Agents, LlamaIndex, Google ADK, Claude Agent SDK, OTel/
OpenInference); ActiveSessionCount metric. Earlier: Web Search GA, Policy + Bedrock Guardrails,
Harness GA, Recommendations GA, Batch Evaluations GA, A/B Testing GA, Managed Knowledge Base GA,
Failure Insights preview, Gateway Runtime/HTTP-passthrough/inference targets, Runtime Interactive
Shells, Step Functions, CLI/CDK payments support.

Updated: 2026-08-21 — five new August entries, four reported. The payments surface (MPP + `upto` +
auto-provisioned wallet credentials) is the most consequential AgentCore movement since Harness GA.
</content>
